title: Prove refreshed setup facts in the installed campaign
text: Source tests cover scoped resume, saved profiles, setting changes and machine observations. Run the existing installer campaign against the released candidate before claiming installed proof; preserve its current execution and owner.
summary: New shared self-host preparation guidance has source coverage in both modes; released interactive/agent delivery remains unproved. Yoke's Windows/WSL runtime and restored home do not establish desktop readiness: non-blank XFCE/xrdp verification and final fresh-host evidence remain unresolved and require separately authorized fixture repair, preserving the failed screenshot check.
